description: For sellers, free: request an x402 (or MPP) endpoint once without paying and check its 402 against the spec (v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, v1 body, CAIP-2 network ids, amount, payTo format, EIP-712 domain for USDC, Solana feePayer, bazaar extension, signed offers of the offer-receipt extension verified against your did:web, CORS), the catalogue listing, OFAC and issuer freezes, and /openapi.json x-payment-info. One lint per host every 10 s. Returns pass / warn / fail / info checks with concrete fixes and a verdict. Also as a GitHub Action: x402 lint by alalanet. Docs: https://alalanet.com/skill.md.

method.description: HTTP method buyers use: GET (default) or POST, as your listing declares; POST sends an empty JSON body

url.description: https URL of your paid x402 (or MPP) endpoint exactly as buyers call it, with any query it needs (path and query included, e.g. .../v1/forecast?city=Lisbon)

name: lint_x402_endpoint
title: Lint your own x402 endpoint
